description: This Java source file contains integration tests for external asset owner transfers within the Apache Fineract project. It includes multiple test cases for initiating, validating, and handling external transfers such as sale and buyback processes for loans, including edge cases like cancellation, overpayment, and multiple transfers. The tests interact with external systems and validate the behavior of external asset ownership transfer workflows.

classes.name: InitiateExternalAssetOwnerTransferTest
classes.description: A JUnit integration test class for testing external asset owner transfer workflows in the Fineract project. It covers scenarios for sale and buyback of loans, including handling cancellations and various edge cases, ensuring the correct state transitions and journal entries.

methods.name: saleActiveLoanToExternalAssetOwnerWithCancelAndBuybackADayLater
methods.description: Test case for selling an active loan, cancelling the transfer, and then buying back the loan a day later, validating external transfer state and journal entries throughout the process.

methods.name: saleActiveLoanToExternalAssetOwnerAndBuybackADayLater
methods.description: Test case for selling an active loan and then buying it back the following day, validating transfer states and journal entries.

methods.name: saleOverpaidLoanToExternalAssetOwnerAndBuybackADayLater
methods.description: Test scenario where the loan is overpaid during sale and buyback occurs a day later, validating the interplay of transfer states and journal entries.

methods.name: saleIsNotAllowedWhenTransferIsAlreadyPending
methods.description: Test ensuring that a sale transfer cannot be initiated when a transfer is already pending for the loan, expecting an exception.

methods.name: saleIsNotAllowedWhenLoanIsNotActive
methods.description: Test to verify that sale transfer is not permitted for loans that are not in active status.

methods.name: saleIsDeclinedWhenLoanIsCancelled
methods.description: Test for declining sale transfer when the loan has been written off (cancelled), validating the transfer status changes.

methods.name: buybackIsExecutedWhenLoanIsCancelled
methods.description: Test that a buyback transfer occurs correctly when the loan is cancelled, and subsequent validation of transfer and journal entries.

methods.name: buybackAndSaleIsCancelledWhenLoanIsCancelled
methods.description: Test for cancelling both sale and buyback transfers when the loan is cancelled, validating statuses.

methods.name: sameDayBuybackAndSaleIsCancelledWhenLoanIsCancelled
methods.description: Test for simultaneous sale and buyback on the same day, and handling their cancellation upon loan cancellation.

methods.name: saleAndBuybackOnTheSameDay
methods.description: Test case for executing sale and buyback transfers on the same day, including validation of transfer states and journal entries.

methods.name: saleAndBuybackMultipleTimes
methods.description: Test for conducting multiple sale and buyback transfers for the same loan, ensuring that duplicate transfers are prevented and state transitions are correct.
